info.title: bConnect Endpoints API
info.description:
Endpoints are the main objects within the baramundi Management Suite (see documentation). These can be manually created or automatically discovered by network scans or via Active Directory synchronization. The methods offered here provide support for manual creation of endpoints and their enrollment. Afterwards the endpoints are ready to be managed by the baramundi Management Suite and jobs can be distributed to these endpoints to gather information or execute logic for the various modules of the baramundi Management Suite (e.g. Compliance, Defense Control, Update Management, etc.).

The bConnect V2 PowerShell module is available from the PowerShell Gallery.

post.summary: Creates a maintenance window for the endpoint

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the endpoint. Only windows endpoints are supported at the moment.

requestBody.description:
The maintenance window to be created. Maintenance windows are defined in respect to the local time of an endpoint. Start and end of a maintenance period are defined using a 24-hour clock in intervals of 15 minutes (e.g. 00:00, 00:15, 17:45, 24:00).

Initialize in PowerShell with `Initialize-bCEndpointsMaintenanceWindowForCreation`

201.description: The maintenance window was created as requested and can be seen in the body of the response.

403.description: The user does not have the necessary permission to modify the endpoint in order to create a maintenance window.

404.description: There is no endpoint with the specified ID.

409.description: A maintenance window already exists for the endpoint.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the endpoint. Only windows endpoints are supported at the moment.

requestBody.description:
A JSON Patch document consists of a set of operations that allow specific partial changes to an object. Maintenance windows are defined in respect to the local time of an endpoint. Start and end of a maintenance period are defined using a 24-hour clock in intervals of 15 minutes (e.g. 00:00, 00:15, 17:45, 24:00).
